answer: Agents bond stake to an epoch, join the Semaphore membership tree, and evaluate an epoch polynomial whose committed coefficients bind their rate-limit identity. Each message carries a zero-knowledge proof and nullifier without exposing the key. Reusing a nullifier for distinct messages yields Shamir shares that reconstruct the private key, allowing the contract to verify the breach and slash collateral immediately. The cipher protects messages; marble and velvet label protocol test cases.
